rationale: ram_zeroshot-claude-agentic: ram_ckpt_path=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ram.pth.tar, ram_input_norm=fbp_max, ram_clamp_output=True, ram_finetune=False, ram_finetune_epochs=0, ram_finetune_lr=0.0001, ram_disable_multiscale=True, ram_disable_cudnn=False, ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False, ram_sigma=0.005, ram_factor=0.55, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.3, val_n=214, rationale=iter-7 (search-20260619-01) PATH B — RETIRE the finetune lever + CONFIRM the FBP-bound ceiling. BASE_ITER=5 (best inference config, SSIM 0.9071 hr 0.0: input_norm=fbp_max, factor=0.55, blend=0.3, sigma=0.005, multiscale off). The prior iter-7 (job 766130) set ram_finetune=True and TIMED OUT: ram.finetune runs PER-SLICE inside the per-slice loop (solver_ram.py L224-243, called at L417 inside for i in range(val_n)) on each slices own y_norm at 35.6M params, ~80s/slice x 214 = ~4.7h, hit the 30-min SLURM wall after ~22 slices, wrote NO row. The solver has NO amortize-once / finetune-subset / train-split knob — finetune is structurally per-sinogram, so PATH A (amortize-then-frozen) is NOT supportable via cfg flags alone (would require hoisting finetune out of the per-slice loop = editing the solver, forbidden). So PATH B: revert ram_finetune=False (pin off), ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False (revert the iter-6 regression probe back to the best inference path), all five inference-scalar levers already mapped at hr 0.0 (blend i2, prox_l2 factor i3, sigma i4, input_norm i5, deepinv-tomo DC path i6), best SSIM 0.9071 @ iter-5. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS not CT pixels): (1) trajectory SSIM 0.861->0.864->0.897->0.902->0.907 (iters 1-5) hr pinned 0.0 throughout; iter-6 deepinv-tomo + iter-7-prev finetune both regressions/timeouts. (2) LIMITER: budget-infeasible per-slice finetune (~80s/slice x214 = 4.7h, 14x over the HARD 1200s budget) + foreign-prior FBP-ceiling: RAM is a frozen zero-shot deepinv denoiser that never saw real LDCT helical-rebinned 2304-view fan data; on dense full-view Mayo LD-FBP is near-complete inversion, the foreign prior only redistributes/smooths -> RMSE stays above the LD-FBP floor (baseline SSIM 0.8078, oracle HD-FBP 0.9331; RAM PSNR ~31-33dB below LD-FBP floor) -> hr pinned 0. (3) ONE knob: ram_finetune True->False (retire the finetune lever; co-revert deepinv_tomo True->False to the best inference path). (4) hypothesis: hr stays EXACTLY 0.0 at SSIM ~0.9071 -- with finetune budget-infeasible AND all five inference levers exhausted, RAM is CONFIRMED structurally FBP-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo. (5) NUMERIC falsifier: if this clean revert lands hr != 0.0 OR SSIM != ~0.907, the prior iter-5 read was not stable; otherwise the ceiling is confirmed and the finetune lever is retired as budget-infeasible (not as a negative architectural result). (6) no control return. BUDGET ARITHMETIC proving <=1200s: this is INFERENCE-ONLY (ram_finetune=False), identical compute profile to iter-5 (985.9s = 16.4 min, well under the HARD 1200s = 20-min budget). Per-slice cost = ~4.6s/slice x 214 single forward passes + one op-norm power iter = ~985s; ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False avoids the extra deepinv-tomo physics evals so this is at or slightly UNDER iter-5s 985.9s. ZERO finetune cost added (finetune off). sbatch --time=00:30:00 backstop. HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted, per-sample-ps (single-val-ps probe, val-only solver), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px FOV DEFAULT (no fov=False).
